title_en: Treasury yields are lower after reaching multiyear highs, traders weigh latest bond auction

summary_ko: 트레이더들이 연준 고위 인사의 발언을 분석하며 추가 장기 채권 입찰을 대기하고 있다.

title_en: Bond yields fall as the Treasury market passes a crucial test of investor confidence

title_en: Treasury yields are 'really, really high' but can come down soon, Bessent's new advisor says

title_en: Trump says U.S. will not attack Iran before midterm election
